Revision.description: Monotonic aggregate revision. Zero is never a persisted revision.

description:
Durable identity of one admitted execution generation of a one-shot task.

The value is created from an authoritative [`TaskResourceStatus`] that is already active and
handed off, then persisted in the owning business service's recovery checkpoint. A resumed
worker proves it still holds the same reservation by matching the identity fields; a new
execution generation always has a new [`TaskRunId`] and therefore a new Resource reservation.

capacityClaimId.description: Capacity claim created by Resource approval.

claimRevision.description: Claim revision observed when this generation was admitted.

executionGeneration.description: Monotonic per-task execution generation. A new generation never reuses a released lease.

leaseId.description: Active lease that authorizes this exact generation to occupy capacity.

leaseRevision.description: Lease revision observed when this generation was admitted.

namespace.description: Exact namespace in which the admitted workload must execute.

providerBinding.description: Capacity provider binding resolved by Resource for this reservation.

resourceRequestId.description: Authoritative Resource request that admitted this generation.

taskRunId.description: Durable one-shot task identity; unique per execution generation.

workloadName.description: Deterministic workload name owned by this execution generation.
